domain: 'DP' for the depot; 'R-<n>' for a robot hub; 'S-<n>' for a drop-off point
description: Location identifier, unique within the instance. Referenced by raw_data.travel_matrices through the shared per-instance location namespace.

Planar x coordinate in the same frame as raw_data.customers. The scale is instance-set specific and carries NO dataset-wide unit -- it is NOT meters, it differs between publications, and values may be negative. NOT a geographic coordinate. Never derive a distance from coordinates; use raw_data.travel_matrices.
Planar y coordinate in the same frame as x_coordinate. Same caveats apply.
Elevation above the frame's reference level. NULL for batches with flat topography.
Access-restricted zone containing this location. NULL means unrestricted.

Role of the node. 'Depot' is the truck depot and occurs exactly once per instance. 'Robot Hub' is a robot hub where robots are stationed. 'Drop-off Point' is a location at which robots may be released but where no robots are stationed.

Number of robots initially stationed at this location. INTENTIONALLY double precision so it can hold IEEE-754 Infinity, denoting unlimited availability. Never cast to integer: the cast cannot represent Infinity and destroys the distinction between 'unlimited' and an arbitrary bound. All finite values are whole numbers. Typically 0 for drop-off points, positive for robot hubs.

Maximum number of robots that can be held at this location. Infinity denotes unlimited capacity, i.e. hub capacity is not a binding constraint in that batch. Same casting caveat as initial_robot_availability. A finite value here is what makes robot reallocation between hubs a constrained decision. Note the three distinct cases: a finite value (capacity binds), Infinity (unlimited capacity), and NULL (capacity is not modeled at all in that batch) -- NULL means 'not applicable', neither zero nor unlimited.
TRUE if the truck can recharge at this location.
Instance this location belongs to. ON DELETE CASCADE.
Earliest permitted service start at this location, relative to the start of the planning horizon (t = 0). NOT a time of day. NULL if no time window applies.
Latest permitted service start at this location, relative to the start of the planning horizon. NULL if no time window applies.
